titleText: JTF News: CBC News, BBC News
mainText: Canada formally requests 16-year renewal of the North American free trade pact.
President Trump appointed Bill Pulte as acting intelligence chief.
Two people were shot dead during protests in Kenya regarding a proposed US Ebola quarantine centre.
Ukraine rescuers pulled deceased individuals from rubble following Russian strikes that killed 18 people.
President Trump signed an order seeking voluntary review of new artificial intelligence models.
